title: Pullman's window over the portico framed like its neighbours
items: On the Pullman house at 1729 Prairie, the upper window over the front portico was a bare arched opening. Every other arched window on the front has a moulded frame.

The 1890 Albertype plate shows that window with the same frame: a moulded band down the sides and round the arch, with small blocks where the arch begins. It now has them. Like the plate, it has no keystone.
